strings.zh: 三之岛原来是水都群岛的工业区。{NEWLINE}出于保护环境的考虑,{CLEAR}精灵联盟将造船业迁到了别处,{CLEAR}并准备把三之岛改造成{CLEAR}纪念造船史的景区。{SCROLL}我便是受雇来进行景区改造的工程师。{NEWLINE}可是当我到达三之岛的时候{CLEAR}却被那里的暴走族给揍了一顿{CLEAR}然后扔进了水里。{CLEAR}要不是这位小姐出手相救,{CLEAR}我恐怕就淹死了。{SCROLL}真没想到水都群岛这么美丽的地方{NEWLINE}居然也会有这种暴徒。
strings.en: Three Island used to be the industrial{NEWLINE}zone of the Alto Mare Islands. But when I got to Three{CLEAR}Island, the bikers there beat me up and{CLEAR}threw me in the sea. If this young lady{CLEAR}hadn’t saved me, I’d probably{CLEAR}have drowned.{SCROLL}I never imagined a place as beautiful as{NEWLINE}the Alto Mare Islands would have thugs{CLEAR}like that.
